summary: A tool's name, description and schema are a prompt. You design the lookup tool properly: a description that says when not to use it, a strict schema, structured errors with a code, a message and a hint, and a permission check that runs first with the caller's role. You also design a writing tool on paper.
goal: Write a tool schema with a clear error result.

items.text: Add tool_design.py and tool_design_cases.py and match the six results
Move the permission check after the input check and say what a customer learns
Return every record and count the characters, and say why that is a problem
Write the tests of the template
Design close_incident on paper: name, description, schema, errors, who may call it
Play the Tool Design Check game to the end and see your score
